description: Rules that hold across every architecture in this knowledge base. Architecture-specific rules belong in their own ruleset.

rules.rule: No circular dependencies between modules or layers
rules.rationale: A cycle means neither participant can be understood, tested or deleted on its own.

rules.rule: Dependencies flow in one direction only, along the order declared by the architecture
rules.rationale: The direction is what makes a layer replaceable. Once it is bidirectional the layering is decorative.

rules.rule: Depend on interfaces, not concrete implementations, across a layer boundary
Consumers must not construct or configure queue infrastructure; take the connection by injection
rules.rationale: A consumer that declares its own queue cannot be tested without a broker, and duplicates retry policy that belongs in one place.

rules.rule: Job handlers must not import the consumer or the queue manager, or any broker client
rules.rationale: Transport independence is what makes the handler unit-testable with a plain object, and what lets the same work move between brokers.

rules.rule: Job handlers must be safe to run more than once on the same payload
rules.rationale: Every mainstream broker is at-least-once. Redelivery is normal operation, not an incident.

rules.rule: Failures must be thrown as typed errors declaring whether they are retryable
rules.rationale: Retrying a terminal failure burns the retry budget and delays the dead-letter that would have surfaced the bug.

rules.rule: Every queue declares a finite retry count and a dead-letter destination
rules.rationale: Without one, a poison message becomes an infinite retry loop that reads as load rather than failure.

rules.rule: Concurrency is configured explicitly, never left at the client default
rules.rationale: The right number is a property of the slowest downstream dependency, which the broker knows nothing about.

rules.rule: Expose queue depth, consumer lag and dead-letter volume as metrics
rules.rationale: Depth alone cannot distinguish a fast producer from a stalled consumer.

rules.rule: Log job id and correlation id on every job lifecycle event
rules.rationale: Asynchronous work is untraceable after the fact without a key that survives the queue hop.

rules.rule: Never hardcode secrets, connection strings or credentials
